messages:
Maya (CSM): quick weekly check-in for Emberfield onboarding — pulled p95/p99 by route/model and streaming vs non-streaming (last 24h). tl;dr: streaming helps p95 but p99 is spikier on /chat-route for gpt-opti-3b. sharing numbers + a couple questions.

Liam (SRE): Numbers (24h, us-west-2):
```
/route/chat (model=gpt-opti-3b)
  streaming: p95=210ms, p99=840ms, errors=0.6%
  non-stream: p95=300ms, p99=1.4s, errors=0.3%
/route/generate (model=gpt-opti-6b)
  streaming: p95=420ms, p99=1.1s, errors=1.1%
  non-stream: p95=480ms, p99=1.6s, errors=0.9%
/embed (model=embed-2)
  both modes p95~45ms p99~120ms, errors<0.1%
```

Nina (Product): interesting — so streaming reduces p95 but p99 spikes more on chat. wonder if KV cache misses or very long prompts cause the tail.

Alex (Eng): checked runtime traces: tail correlates with KV cache misses + large contexts (tokens > 4k) and occasional quantized-kernel fallback on some nodes. also saw a canary around 2367999000 from @deploy-bot that did a warm restart — possible contributor.

deploy-bot: canary rollout: model=gpt-opti-3b variant=v2 -> 3% traffic @ 2367999000

OncallBot: alert: 3 autoscale events in last 24h for Emberfield's dedicated pool due to sustained queue length > 20. no capacity violations.

Maya (CSM): actions: 1) Eng - can you run a prefix cache-priming experiment and sample traces specifically for streaming p99? 2) CS - i'll schedule an enablement w/ emberfield and warn them about tail behavior. 3) Finance - spend +18% WoW; flagging potential renewal risk if latency persists. who owns spend flag?

Liam (SRE): i'll pull cache hit-rate heatmap and correlate with requests >4096 tokens. quick note: prefix caching is enabled for /route/chat for Emberfield with TTL=60s currently.

Alex (Eng): plan: small experiment -> increase prefix TTL to 300s for Emberfield nightly windows, add synthetic priming for heavy-turn prompts. roll canary at 03:00 PT, monitor p99 & errors. ETA ~48h. will post results in this thread.

Nina (Product): cs notes: Emberfield runs large sync ingestion at 02:00 PT that spikes token counts. i'll ask them to stagger jobs. they're confirmed for enablement on Wed 10:00 PT.

Maya (CSM): :thumbsup: also capturing customer feedback — they said 'streaming sometimes lags mid-doc' which could be client reassembly or server rebuffer. alex, please include client logs in the trace capture.

Alex (Eng): will add client-side correlation-ids to traces and request Emberfield attach client logs for next session.

Liam (SRE): noted. i'll also surface the request distribution by model-version & node to see if a small subset of nodes are producing the tail.

Maya (CSM): tagging follow-ups: @Alex (Eng) experiment + traces, @Liam (SRE) cache heatmap + node distribution, @Nina (Product) customer ask to stagger ingestion, i'll set renewal risk=medium if p99 not improved in 14 days. reminder: next sync in 7 days.

Alex (Eng): ok. will push canary and update here.

Maya (CSM): thanks team — capturing for the account doc and CS renewal board.
